text: 848 adds the notification stylesheet link when building the component shadow tree and registers its illustrations and icon assets in jar.inc.mn. Storybook supplies its own theme/icon environment. A story import does not package or style the production shadow tree. Check production link, skin registration and story setup together when adding component assets. No Storybook or packaged UI was launched.
title: Include a component stylesheet in the shadow tree that consumes it
